items.lang|kerria|kerria.fastUpload.tooltip:
Optimize CPU -> GPU texture upload with persistently mapped buffers and pixel buffer objects.

Requires OpenGL 4.5 support or ARB_direct_state_access and ARB_buffer_storage.
items.lang|kerria|kerria.cache.tooltip:
Cache uploaded textures to eliminate CPU -> GPU upload, and transfer sub-textures between GPU memory directly

Requires OpenGL 4.5 support or ARB_direct_state_access, ARB_copy_image and ARB_texture_storage.
items.lang|kerria|kerria.bufferSize.tooltip: Specifies the size of the persistently mapped buffer, in KBs
items.lang|kerria|kerria.minCacheSize.tooltip: Specifies the initial cache size for animated textures
items.lang|kerria|kerria.maxCacheSize.tooltip: Specifies the maximum cache size for animated textures
